name: Small Business Automation
audience: Owners and office managers of small HVAC, plumbing, roofing, dental and physiotherapy businesses in North America who are buried in calls, quotes and admin.
voice: Plain-spoken, practical and confident. Short sentences. Talks like an operator who builds workflows, not a hype account. Shows the workflow and what changes for the business.
pillars:
Missed calls and after-hours answering
Lead response and booking
Quotes and follow-up
Reminders, no-shows and recalls
Invoices, reviews and referrals
Owner mindset: where to start with automation
rules:
Never invent statistics, percentages or dollar figures
Healthcare workflows are administrative only: no clinical advice or diagnosis
Show outcomes as before/after, not promises
No hype words like revolutionary, game-changer or 10x
Every post names a real task a small business does daily
ctas:
Save this for when you're ready to automate ⚙️
Send this to a business owner who's buried in admin
Which workflow should I map next? Tell me below 👇
Follow @automatesmallbusiness for one practical workflow a day
